# Pranav Yerramaneni

> Firmware and robotics engineer in Santa Clara, California: real-time control for humanoid robots, machine learning on small hardware, and robotics classes for elementary-school kids. B.S. Computer Science at UC Santa Cruz, class of 2029. Open to firmware, robotics and applied-ML internships for summer 2027.

The site is a single page. Everything on it is in the full-text file below; the other links are the primary sources behind it.

## Site

- [Agent page, HTML](https://devmello.xyz/ai/): the same text as a plain web page without scripts or navigation.
- [Home page, HTML](https://devmello.xyz/): the human version, with a live reaction-wheel pendulum demo.
